meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把项目里的每个源文件逐个完整读完,大文件用 Read 工具的 offset、limit 参数分段翻页读,不跳过任何文件。目的是先建立对整个代码库的了解,再开始干活。
howto.when: 当你开始接触一个新项目或不熟悉的项目,或说到「learn the codebase」「read the codebase」「prime」等词时接管。

say.text: 帮我学习一下这个代码库
say.note: 它会开始逐个完整读取源文件

say.text: 我要接手一个陌生项目,先通读代码
say.note: 读完后再开始后续工作

say.text: 这个大文件用 offset 和 limit 分页读完
say.note: 按每段 500 行左右分段读

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads every source file in the project in full, one by one, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters. The goal is to build an understanding of the codebase before working on it.
howto.when_en: Use when you start on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you say "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", etc.

say_en.note: It starts reading every source file in full

say_en.text: I'm taking over an unfamiliar project, read the code first
say_en.note: Work continues after the full read

say_en.text: Page through this large file with offset and limit
say_en.note: Reads in chunks of about 500 lines
